ovwSpacing.description: Card title for the spacing scale, gaps and card padding. [max:0]

ovwStyleRules.description: Overview stat: how many CSS rules the page defines. [max:0]

ovwStyles_one.description: Overview typography summary, SINGULAR. Shorter than fntTextStyles — a compact card. {n}=1 [max:0]

ovwStylesheets.description: Overview stat label: how many stylesheets the page loads. [max:0]

ovwTotal.description: Third stat pill in the Overview contrast summary, beside Pass and Fail: how many text elements were measured. [max:90px] [font:11/600]

ovwUnknown.description: Stat value shown when a page property could not be determined. [max:120px] [font:13/600]

ovwViewAll.description: Link on an Overview summary card that opens the full panel. [max:110px] [font:11/500]

ovwWeightDocument.description: Page-weight category: the HTML document itself. [max:0]

ovwWeightFetch.description: Page-weight category: background data requests. 'Fetch/XHR' is DevTools' own wording — mirror whatever Chrome DevTools shows in your language, or keep it as-is. [max:0]

ovwWeightOther.description: Page-weight category: everything else (fonts, media, etc.). [max:0]

preCancel.description: Button in the pre-capture overlay that aborts before anything is sent to Figma. Sits beside the progress label, so a long word steals room from it. [max:80px] [font:12/500]

preCancelling.description: Replaces the progress label after Cancel is pressed, while the abort finishes. Note the single-character ellipsis (…), not three dots. [max:216px] [font:12/500]

preProgress.description: Pre-capture overlay label while the page is scrolled and settled. {p} is the percentage. Keep the trailing % adjacent to the number as your language writes it (fr uses a narrow no-break space before %). Truncates with an ellipsis past the budget. {p}=88 [max:216px] [font:12/500]

preStarting.description: Pre-capture overlay label once scrolling is done and the capture engine takes over. Same slot as preProgress. [max:216px] [font:12/500]

roleBody.description: Element role for generic <span>/<div> text — ordinary body copy. [max:0]

roleCaption.description: Element role for <figcaption>/<caption> — text describing a figure or table. [max:0]

roleCode.description: Element role for <code>/<pre>/<kbd>. Meaning source code, not a passcode. [max:0]

roleEmphasis.description: Element role for <em>/<i> — italic, emphasised text. [max:0]

roleHeading.description: Element role for h1–h6. {level} is the digit 1-6 and is appended in code. {level}=2 [max:0]

roleInput.description: Element role for <input>/<textarea> — a form field. [max:0]

roleLabel.description: Element role for <label> — a form field's caption. [max:0]

roleStrong.description: Element role for <strong>/<b> — bold, strongly emphasised text. [max:0]

roleText.description: Element role shown beside a text style: generic text with no more specific role. Role names label what an element IS on the page. [max:0]

selCaptured.description: Bottom-centre pill shown after picking an element inside a cross-origin iframe, where the clipboard write needs one more click. [max:200px] [font:14/400]

selCopied.description: Replaces the pill text on success. The em dash joins two clauses — use whatever your language would (ja/zh: 。, de: comma). [max:340px] [font:14/400]

selCopyFailed.description: Replaces the pill text when the clipboard write is rejected. [max:340px] [font:14/400]

selCopyToFigma.description: Button in that pill; clicking it performs the clipboard write. 'Figma' is a product name. [max:170px] [font:13/600]

selPickCancel.description: Button beside selPickPrompt that leaves element-pick mode without capturing. Seeded from the capture engine's own catalog (key cancel). Distinct from preCancel, which aborts a capture already in progress — both are frozen English, keep them as separate keys. [max:120px] [font:12/500]

selPickPrompt.description: Prompt in the dark bar during element-pick mode, while the user hovers to choose what to export. Rendered by an E2F override inside capture.js but SET from background.js's reskinSelectPrompt(). Seeded from the capture engine's own catalog (key selectElementToCapture) so both surfaces match. Bar is content-sized and grows. [max:0]

setFaq.description: Label of one of three side-by-side buttons in the Settings panel's Help & support strip. Each is a third of ~336px, leaving 92px of room, and the text does NOT wrap — keep it to one or two short words. Deliberately terse; the hover tooltip repeats it. [max:92px] [font:11/500]

setHelpSection.description: Section heading inside the Settings panel. Rendered UPPERCASE with letter-spacing by makeSection — do not add capitals yourself, and avoid German ß here (Chrome uppercases it to SS). [max:330px] [font:10/600]

setLangAuto.description: First option in the language dropdown: follow the browser's language. {name} is the endonym of whatever the browser currently resolves to and is NEVER translated. Keep the · separator. Rendered inside a full-width control that ellipsizes; the budget is the real available width. {name}=Português (Brasil); [max:250px] [font:12/500]

setLanguageSection.description: Section heading inside the Settings panel, above the language picker. Rendered UPPERCASE with letter-spacing by makeSection — do not add capitals yourself, and avoid German ß here (Chrome uppercases it to SS). [max:330px] [font:10/600]

setLifetime.description: Validity value for a Pro account with no expiry date — the lifetime/promo plan. Shown in the settings profile card where a dated plan shows setRenewsOn instead. The landing site uses the same single word. [max:170px] [font:11/400]

setManageSub.description: Full-width primary action in the profile card for Pro accounts; opens the billing portal. Ellipsizes rather than wraps. [max:280px] [font:12/600]

setNotSignedIn.description: Single centred line in the Settings profile card when nobody is signed in, directly above the Sign In button. An INVITATION, not a warning — signing in is what makes exporting possible at all, so lead with the action. Fits on one line in every locale (widest is ~229px against 310px of room); keep it to one short sentence and do not add the export quota, which the toolbar already states. [max:300px] [font:11/400]

setPlanFree.description: Value of the Plan row for a free account. The paid counterpart is authPro, which renders as a green pill instead. A plan tier name — keep it short. [max:104px] [font:11/600]

setPrivacy.description: Label of one of three side-by-side buttons in the Settings panel's Help & support strip. Each is a third of ~336px, leaving 92px of room, and the text does NOT wrap — keep it to one or two short words. Deliberately terse; the hover tooltip repeats it. [max:92px] [font:11/500]

setRateExtension.description: Full-width secondary button below the brand marquee, near the panel footer; opens the Chrome Web Store listing. It is no longer squeezed beside another button, so a fuller two-word form is fine here. Ellipsizes rather than wraps. [max:280px] [font:12/600]

setRenewsOn.description: Sub-line under the export counter for PRO accounts: when the subscription renews. {date} arrives already formatted by Intl in the user's language — do not reword or reformat it. Rendered in a nowrap card-footer cell beside authUnlimitedExports; the two must fit together. {date}=24. März 2026; [max:170px] [font:11/400]

setReportBug.description: Label of one of three side-by-side buttons in the Settings panel's Help & support strip. Each is a third of ~336px, leaving 92px of room, and the text does NOT wrap — keep it to one or two short words. Deliberately terse; the hover tooltip repeats it. [max:92px] [font:11/500]

setResetsOn.description: Sub-line under the export counter for FREE accounts: when the monthly quota rolls over. {date} arrives already formatted by Intl in the user's language — do not reword or reformat it. Rendered in a nowrap card-footer cell beside the export count; the two must fit together. {date}=1. Sept.; [max:170px] [font:11/400]

setTitle.description: Two places: the gear icon's hover tooltip in the inspect icon row, and the Settings panel's own header. The tooltip is nowrap with an ellipsis fallback. [max:200px] [font:11/500]

setUpgradeBtn.description: Upsell button on the Settings profile card — mkBigBtn('gold'), full width, with a separate ✦ glyph the code adds (do NOT put it in this string). Roomier than the toolbar, so this one names the plan explicitly where the toolbar's tbUpgradeBtn stays short. Does not wrap. [max:260px] [font:12/600]

setVersionLabel.description: Shown in the Settings panel header, right-aligned next to the close button and concatenated with the version number ("Version 1.2.0"). Shares the header row with the panel title and the close button, so it must stay short. Does not wrap. [max:150px] [font:11/500]

tbCopied.description: Brief confirmation that flashes in place of a copy button after the clipboard write succeeds. Keep it short — it replaces an icon-sized label. [max:110px] [font:11/500]

tbCopy.description: Generic copy-to-clipboard button label, reused across the inspect panels. [max:110px] [font:12/500]

tbExportBtn.description: Primary toolbar button: capture the whole page. Also restored here after a failed export attempt. [max:140px] [font:12/600]

tbFreeLimitReached.description: Bottom-row headline when a free user is out of exports. Deliberately separate from authLimitReached ('Monthly limit reached'), which the service worker sets — both wordings are frozen English. [max:200px] [font:12/600]

tbFreeMonthlyExports.description: Bottom-row sub-line for signed-out users, stating what the free tier gives. The number 10 is the real quota — keep it. Truncates past the budget. [max:260px] [font:12/400]

tbNudgeReviewBtn.description: Gold button of the review nudge; opens the Chrome Web Store listing. Meaning: 'write a review', not 'review this document'. [max:140px] [font:12/500]

tbNudgeReviewHelps.description: Sub-line of the review nudge, meaning a Web Store review supports the product. [max:260px] [font:12/400]

tbNudgeSavedTime.description: Review nudge, shown after several successful exports beside a gold ★. A friendly rhetorical question — keep it warm and short, not corporate. A non-breaking space is added before this text in code, so do not add leading whitespace. [max:150px] [font:12/600]

tbSelectElementBtn.description: Toolbar button that starts hover-and-click element picking. Sits beside tbExportBtn; the toolbar WIDENS to fit rather than wrapping. [max:200px] [font:12/500]

tbSignInBtn.description: Primary toolbar button shown when nobody is signed in; also replaces the Export button when a session expires. The longest button in the toolbar, and the toolbar WIDENS to fit rather than wrapping. [max:220px] [font:12/600]

tbSignInToSync.description: Bottom-row headline for signed-out users, meaning their export count syncs across devices once they sign in. [max:170px] [font:12/600]

tbUpgradeBtn.description: Upsell button. TWO surfaces, BOTH on the toolbar: the Export button once a free user is out of exports, and the bottom-row link. Keep it SHORT — it is the same word the bottom-row link morphs to in authUpgradeArrow on a 403, and the two must agree. The Settings card uses setUpgradeBtn instead, which can be longer. Does not wrap. [max:160px] [font:12/600]

tbUpgradeForUnlimited.description: Bottom-row sub-line when the free limit is reached. Keep the trailing period if your language uses one. [max:260px] [font:12/400]
tbUpgradeForUnlimited.message: Passa a Pro per esportazioni illimitate.

tbVpCustom.description: Viewport preset where the user types their own pixel width. This one IS ordinary prose — translate it. Shown in the toolbar trigger where space is tightest. [max:110px] [font:12/500]

tbVpDesktop.description: Viewport preset in the toolbar dropdown (~1440px wide capture). Device-class names like these are commonly left in English in design tools — translate only if your language genuinely does. [max:150px] [font:12/500]

tbVpMobile.description: Viewport preset (~390px wide capture). Same guidance as tbVpDesktop. [max:150px] [font:12/500]

tbVpTablet.description: Viewport preset (~834px wide capture). Same guidance as tbVpDesktop. [max:150px] [font:12/500]

uiClose.description: Tooltip / aria-label on the ✕ icon button that closes an inspect panel. Icon-only button, so this text is never rendered inline. Shared by every panel. [max:0]

unsupFileBtn.description: Button that opens this extension's own chrome://extensions details page, where the toggle lives. [max:0]

unsupFileNote.description: Reassuring footnote on the file:// popup. Keep the friendly, non-alarming tone; this is a limitation, not an error. [max:0]
unsupFileNote.message: Da sapere: le immagini salvate sul tuo computer non vengono catturate — è un limite di Chrome. Tutto il resto funziona.

unsupFileSettingName.description: The exact name of the Chrome setting the user must toggle. Open chrome://extensions IN THIS LANGUAGE and copy Chrome's own wording verbatim — this must match what the user actually sees, so do not invent a translation. [max:0]
unsupFileSettingName.message: Consenti accesso agli URL dei file

unsupFileStep1.description: First instruction line on the file:// popup, introducing the button below it. [max:0]
unsupFileStep1.message: Per i file locali Chrome richiede un permesso:

unsupFileStep2.description: Second instruction. {setting} is rendered BOLD and is unsupFileSettingName — keep the placeholder, and place it where your language needs it. {setting}=Allow access to file URLs [max:0]
unsupFileStep2.message: Lì attiva {setting}, ricarica la pagina e fai di nuovo clic sull’icona.

unsupFileTitle.description: Popup headline on a local file:// page, where Chrome requires an explicit permission. [max:0]

unsupSub.description: Popup sub-line telling the user what to do instead. Wraps freely in a 400px popup. [max:0]
unsupSub.message: Apri una pagina web e fai di nuovo clic sull’estensione

unsupTitle.description: Popup headline when the extension is clicked on a page it cannot capture (chrome://, the Web Store, etc.). [max:0]

wcagFairAALarge.description: Contrast rating badge: passes only for LARGE text under WCAG AA. Keep 'AA' — it is the standard's level name. [max:130px] [font:11/600]

wcagGood.description: Contrast rating badge: meets WCAG AA. [max:90px] [font:11/600]

wcagGreat.description: Contrast rating badge: meets WCAG AAA. One short word — sits in a tight coloured pill. [max:90px] [font:11/600]

wcagPoor.description: Contrast rating badge: fails WCAG minimums. [max:90px] [font:11/600]

zipBundling.description: Progress text while assets are gathered, before compression starts. [max:0]

zipDownload.description: Button that saves the prepared archive. 'ZIP' is a file format — keep it. [max:180px] [font:12/600]

zipDownloadAgain.description: Offers a repeat download of the same archive. [max:200px] [font:12/500]

zipDownloaded.description: Confirmation replacing the download button once the file is saved. [max:180px] [font:12/600]

zipErrCouldNotBuild.description: Shown when assembling the ZIP throws. [max:0]

zipErrCouldNotStart.description: Shown when the ZIP job cannot be started at all. [max:0]

zipErrFailed.description: Shown in the assets panel when the ZIP build reports a failure. [max:0]

zipErrNoImages.description: Shown when every asset in the ZIP request failed to download (usually cross-origin blocks). Produced in the SERVICE WORKER and sent to the panel, so it is looked up there, not at the producer. [max:0]
zipErrNoImages.message: Non è stato possibile scaricare alcuna immagine.

zipErrTimedOut.description: Shown when the ZIP build exceeds its time limit. [max:0]

zipReadyFiles_many.description: ZIP export complete, PLURAL. Keep the ✓ and em dash. {n}=88 [max:0]

zipReadyFiles_one.description: ZIP export complete, SINGULAR. KEEP the leading ✓ and the em dash. A size and an optional skipped-count are appended in code. {n}=1 [max:0]

zipReadyFiles_other.description: ZIP export complete, PLURAL. Keep the ✓ and em dash. {n}=88 [max:0]

zipSkipped.description: Appended after zipReadyFiles when some assets could not be fetched (cross-origin, 404). {n}=88 [max:0]

zipZipping.description: Progress text while the downloaded assets are compressed. [max:0]
